वंश: वंश वंश,  I. m.  1. A bambu, Hit. pr. d. 23, M.M.; a staff, Indr. 1, 8.  2. Lineage, race, Bhartṛ. 2, 24; Vikr. d. 153; bambu (or tree in general), and race, Pañc. ii. d. 189.  3. वंह्: वंह् वंह्, see बंह् and 2. रंह्।
वक: वक वक, m.  1. A crane, Ardea nivea, Pañc. ii. d. 87.  2. The name of a demon.  3. Kuvera.  4. An ap-paratus for subliming metals.

वकोट: वकोट वकोट (from वक), m. A crane.
वक्तव्यता: वक्तव्यता वक्तव्य + ता (vb. वच्), f.  1. The nature of what is to be said.  2. Blame, Man. 8, 230.
वक्तुकाम: वक्तुकाम वक्तुकाम, i. e. वक्तुम् -काम (vb. वच्), adj. Desirous of speaking, wishing to say, Vikr. 30, 1.

वक्र: वक्र वक्र, i. e. वङ्क् + र,  I. adj.  1. Crooked, Pañc. iii. d. 75; bent, Śāk. d. 9; with पथिन्, a round-about way, Megh. 28.  2. Indirect, evasive.  3. The bend of a river.  -- Comp. अष्टा-, m. a proper name, MBh. 3, 10599.

वक्षोज: वक्षोज वक्षोज, i. e. वक्षस्-ज, n. The female breast, Sāh. Darp. 307, 7.
वक्षोरुह्: वक्षोरुह् वक्षोरुह् (Lass. 66, 8), and वक्षोरुह वक्षोरुह, i. e. वक्षस्-रुह् and रुह्, + अ, m. The female breast.
वख्: † वख् वख्, वङ्ख् वङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go.

वङ्क: वङ्क वङ्क् + अ,  I. m.  1. The bend of a river.  2. Crookedness.  II. f. का, The pommel of a saddle.

वङ्ग्: † वङ्ग् वङ्ग्, i. 1, Par.  1. To go.  2. To limp. -- Cf. वङ्क्।
वङ्ग: वङ्ग वङ्ग,  I. m.  1. Cotton.  2. The name of a country, Bengal.  3. Its in-habitants, Ragh. 4, 36.  II. n.  1. Lead.  2. Tin.
वङ्घ्: † वङ्घ् वङ्घ्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To go.  2. To blame.  3. To begin moving.  4. To begin.  5. To move swiftly.

Fit or proper to be said.  2. Reprehensible.  3. One of bad fame, Man. 8, 66.  4. Vile, low.  5. De-pendant, subject. n.  1. A rule.  2. Speak-ing, Pañc. 194, 23.  3. Speech. P. 8, 27. n. evil tidings, Rām. 5, 15, 42. Comp. absol. अन् -उक्त्वा, without being ordered, Rājat. 5, 62. Desider. विवक्ष, To desire to speak, to say to, Chr. 57, 26. Caus. वाचय।  1. To read, Śāk. 17, 4; Vikr. 26, 3. -- With अभि अभि, To address, to say to (with two acc.), MBh. 2, 1998. -- With निस् निस्,  1. To declare, MBh. 3, 1223; to explain, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 204, 11.  2. Subjection, Pañc. iii. d. 10; 30; वशे कृ, To overpower, Rām. 3, 55, 7; submission, Pañc. iv. d. 60; वशे भू, To be sub-jected, to obey, Rām. 3, 55, 18.  4. Birth.  IV. m.  1. The residence of harlots.  2. A proper name, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.  V. f. शा।  1. A wife.  2. A daughter.  3. A husband's sister.  4. A woman.  5. A cow.  6. A female elephant, Vikr. d. 110.  7. A barren cow.  8. A barren woman, Man. 8, 28.  -- Comp. अ-, adj., f. शा, 1. having no free will, unwilling, against one's wish, Rām. 2, 59, 4; powerless, Hit. iii. d. 133; without being able to resist, Rām. 4, 6, 12; Man. 5, 33. 2. unsubdued, Hit. i. d. 17, M.M.  3. disobedient, Hit. ii. d. 173. °शम्, adv. necessarily, Hit. ii. d. 75. अङ्कुश-, adj. obey-ing the goad of an elephant, Pañc. i. d. 373. आत्मवश, i. e. आत्मन्-,  I. m. subjection to one's self, Hit. ii. d. 54, M.M.  II. adj. independent, Man. 4, 159. कर्मवश, i. e. कर्मन्-, adj. dependent upon the acts performed in former existences, MBh. 13, 72. क्रो-ध-,  I. (m.), the power of wrath, Man. 2, 214.  II. adj. 1. ruled by wrath, Bhāg. P. 5, 24, 29. 2. the name of several bad spirits. दैव-, n. will of fate, Pañc. 160, 17; 174, 25. निद्रा-(n.), sleep (literally, power of sleep), Pañc. 37, 7. पर-, adj. depending on another, Hit. i. d. 201, M.M. मन्-त्र-ओषधि-, adj. to be overcome by charms and herbs, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3197. मोह- (n.), unconsciousness (literally, power of unconsciousness), Chr. 36, 21. वि-, adj., f. शा (deprived of will). 1. subject, subjected, Rām. 3, 55, 51; Hit. i. d. 171, M.M. (even against their will). 2. independent. 3. uncontrolled, unsubdued. 4. apprehensive of death, Bhartṛ. 2, 29. 5. desirous of death, having the soul free from worldly cares, dead, Ragh. 8, 81. स्व-, adj. self-controlled, ruled by one's free will, Hiḍ. 4, 4; inde-pendent, Vikr. d. 37.
वशंवदत्व: वशंवदत्व वशं-वद-त्व, i.e. वश + म्-वद् + अ + त्व, n. Speaking compliantly, Ragh. 18, 12.
वशग: वशग वश + ग,  1. adj. Obedient, subject, MBh. 3, 14687; Pañc. i. d. 155; 285.  2. f. गा, An obedient wife.
वशतस्: वशतस् वश + तस्, adv. In conse-quence, or on account, of the power of, Bhartṛ. 2, 91.
वशता: वशता वश + ता, f. Subjection, Cāṇ. 65 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 411.
वशि: वशि वश् + इ, n. Subduing by magical means, bewitching.
वशिता: वशिता वशि + ता, f. वशित्व वशि + त्व, n., or वशिन् + ता, or त्व,  1. Subduing by magical means, Lass. 3, 19 (त्व).  2. Sub-jugation, dominion, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2977.
वशिन्: वशिन् वशिन्, i. e. वश + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी, Subdued.  II. m. One who has subdued his senses, a sage, Śāk. d. 47.  III. f. नी।  1. A tree, Mimosa Sama Roxb.  2. A parasite plant.
वशिर: वशिर वशिर,  I. m. The name of seve-ral plants.  II. n. Sea salt (cf. वसुक).
वशिष्ठ: वशिष्ठ वशिष्ठ (in the Vedas वसिष्ठ वसिष्ठ, properly superl. of वसु), m. The name of a Ṛṣi, Man. 1, 35; Chr. 296, 9 = Rigv. i. 112, 9 (स्).
वशीकरण: वशीकरण वशीकरण, i. e. वश-कृ + अन,  1. Subduing in general, Pañc. i. d. 80.  2. Subduing by magical expedients.
वश्य: वश्य वश्य, i. e. वश + य,  I. adj., f. या।  1. Governable, able to be subdued, Pañc. iii. d. 128; subdued, Pañc. 156, 10; 23, 3; being in one's power, 146, 24.  2. Obedient, ib. 46, 20.  II. m. A dependent, a slave.  III. f. या, An obedient wife.  IV. n. Cloves.  -- Comp. अ-वश्य + म्, see s. v. काम-, adj. subdued by love, MBh. 3, 11590.
वश्यकता: ऽवश्यकता -वश्यकता, in अ-, i. e. अ -वश्य + क + ता, f. Necessity, Hit. 116, 10.
वष्: † वष् वष्, बष् बष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt or kill.
वषट्: वषट् वषट् (probably for वक्षत्, ved. conj. aor. of वह्), ind. An excla-mation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire; cf. कृ।
वषट्कार: वषट्कार वषट्-कार, m. Oblation with fire, Hariv. 11187.
वषट्कृति: वषट्कृति वषट्-कृति, f. Oblation with fire, Lass. 100, 11 = Rigv. vii. 11, 6.
वष्क्: † वष्क् वष्क्, विष्क् विष्क्, i. 10, Par. To see; see वस्क्।
वष्क: वष्क वष्क, वष्कय वष्कय, and वस्कय वस्कय, i. e. 1. वस् + क, and वस् + क + य, m. A one-year-old calf.  -- Cf. Lat. vacca.
वष्कयणी: वष्कयणी वष्कयणी, वस्कयणी वस्-कयणी, and वष्कयिणी वष्कयिणी (i. e. वष्कय + इन् + ई; cf. the last), f. A cow bearing many calves.
वस्: 1. वस् वस्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 48, 21).  1. To dwell, MBh. 1, 749; sometimes with वासम्, Man. 2, 242; Chr. 60, 30; to dwell with (with the loc.), Nal. 15, 7.  2. To pass (the night), Rām. 1, 29, 1.  3. To live, Hit. 127, 11 (अस्मद्-सेवया, as our servant). Pass. imps. उष्य, Pañc. 30, 24 (उष्यताम्, may it be lived). Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उषित।  1. Dwelt, having dwelt, Chr. 11, 13.  2. Remaining in or on.  3. Stale. Anomal. ptcple. of the fut. pass. वास्तव्य, To be dwelt, Pañc. iii. d. 236. m.  1. An inhabitant, a citizen, Pañc. 48, 25.  2. A kinsman, a dependent.  Comp. ग्राम-, m. the inhabitant of a village, MBh. 12, 4803. Anomal. absol. उष्य, Rām. 1, 48, 8. Caus. वासय,  1. To cause to dwell, MBh. 4, 278; to lodge, Hit. 92, 19.  2. To people, Hit. iii. d. 95.  3. To receive hospitably, MBh. 3, 982.  4. To let abide, MBh. 4, 5600. वासित, Well peopled, Hit. iii. d. 95; see s. v. † i. 10, Par. वसय, To dwell. -- With the prep. अधि अधि,  1. To inhabit, Rām. 1, 34, 46.  2. To dwell, Utt. Rāmac. 55, 16. Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. समयाध्युषित, see s. v. -- With अनु अनु,  1. To dwell with (with acc.), Rām. 2, 37, 26.  2. To inhabit, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 75. -- With अन्तर् अन्तर् (adv.), To dwell in, Śiś. 3, 9. -- With आ आ  1. To dwell with (with acc.), Rām. 2, 50, 2.  2. To inhabit, MBh. 3, 8032.  3. To have an adulterous connection with (acc.), Man. 8, 374.  4. To dwell, MBh. 3, 2014.  5. To undergo, to assume, Man. 3, 2. Caus.  1. To receive, Rām. 2, 12, 101.  2. To inhabit, MBh. 3, 12188. -- With अध्या अधि-आ, To in-habit, MBh. 1, 5512. -- With समा सम् -आ, To inhabit, Rām. 2, 54, 41. Caus. To pitch, Hit. 84, 11, M.M. (समावासित-क-टक, adj. Having pitched his camp). --With उद् उद्, Caus. To expel, Pañc. 47, 6. -- With उप उप,  1. To inhabit.  2. To fast, Man. 2, 220. उपोषित,  1. Fasted.  2. Who has fasted, Pañc. 199, 12.  3. Fasting. n. Fast, Man. 5, 155. Caus. To cause to fast, to instruct to fast, Rām. 2, 5, 4. -- With नि नि,  1. To dwell, Pañc. 160, 23; Man. 2, 24.  2. To pass (the night), MBh. 4, 276. --With अधिनि अधि-नि, To dwell near (with acc.), Bhartṛ. 3, 77. -- With संनि सम्-नि, To dwell, MBh. 3, 16777. -- With निस् निस्, To dwell abroad, MBh. 3, 915(?). Caus.  1. To expel, MBh. 2, 2644; Pañc. iii. d. 270.  2. To banish, Utt. Rāmac. 112, 6. -- With परि परि, पर्युषित,  1. One who has passed the night, Pañc. 40, 13.  2. Stale, not fresh, Man. 4, 211; Pañc. ii. d. 102 (of a flower); Häberl. Anthol. 6, 4.  3. Insipid, Nal. 12, 13; MBh. 3, 2856. -- With प्र प्र,  1. To dwell abroad, Rām. 2, 36, 8.  2. To order to dwell abroad, Rām. 2, 41, 6. प्रोषित,  1. Departed, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 11.  2. Absent, being on a journey, Megh. 49. Caus. To send abroad, to banish, Man. 8, 123. -- With विप्र वि-प्र, To dwell abroad, Man. 2, 132. विप्रो-षित, Having been abroad, Rām. 2, 103, 26. Caus. To banish, Man. 8, 219. --With प्रति प्रति,  1. To dwell near, Hit. 110, 2.  2. To dwell, Pañc. 32, 23. --With वि वि,  1. To dwell, to pass, Rām. 1, 23, 23.  2. To pass away, Pañc. 130, 7. Caus.  1. To dismiss, MBh. 3, 8277.  2. To banish, Man. 8, 123. -- With सम् सम्,  1. To dwell, or to live with (with the acc.), Man. 11, 190.  2. To cohabit (acc.), Man. 9, 77. -- Cf. Goth. visan; A.S. wesan, ed-wist, werig; O.H.G. wesan and werên, wonên; A.S. wunian; Lat. Vesta, vestibulum, verna; ἄστυ, ἀστοός, ἑστία, ὑπερ-ῷον, probably εὐνή, ἰαύω, αὐλή, αὖλις.

2. वस् वस् (the original form of उष्, q. cf.), base of the present, उच्छ, i. 6, Par. To shine, Chr. 287, 3 = Rigv. i. 48, 3 (उच्छात्, conj. imperf., and उवास, pf. red.). Infin. वस्तवे, ib. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2. --With the prep. वि वि, व्युष्ट, see sepa-rately. -- Cf. Goth. uhtvo, see उषस्।

3. वस् वस्, ii. 2, Ātm.  1. To wear, as clothes, Man. 1, 101; 2, 41.  2. To put on, Man. 4, 116. -- With नि नि, To put on, Nal. 10, 29. Caus. To put on, MBh. 3, 2631. -- With प्र प्र, To put on, Rām. 2, 100, 30. -- With प्रति प्रति, Caus. To dress, MBh. 2, 2502. --With वि वि, Caus. To put on, MBh. 2, 2520. -- Cf. Goth. vasjan (to wear), vasti; A.S. werian; Lat. vestis; ἔννψμι, εἷμα (= ved. वस्मन्, Rigv. iv. 13, 4), ἐσθής.
† 4. वस् वस्, i. 4, Par. To be un-bending.
5. वस् वस्, i. 10, वासय, Par.  1. † To love.  2. To cut.  3. † To take, or to offer, or to kill.
वसति: वसति and ती वसती̆ (vb. 1. वस्), f.  1. A dwelling-place, Vikr. d. 137 (ति); Pañc. 123, 16 (ति, at the end of a comp. adj.).  2. A house, Nalod. 4, 29.  3. (perhaps vb. 3. वस्), Night, Sāv. 4, 5; figurat., Chr. 48, 4 (ति).  -- Comp. गर्भ-वसति, f. the womb, Hariv. 3312. दुर्वसति, i. e. दुस्-, f. an uneasy dwelling, Ragh. 8, 93. रमण-वसति, f. the dwelling-place of the lover, Megh. 38.
वसन: वसन 1. 3. वस् + अन, n.  1. A dwel-ling.  2. Covering.  3. Cloth, Vikr. d. 115.  4. Also f. ना, An ornament worn by women round the loins.  -- Comp. सु-, adj., f. ना, elegantly attired, Johns. Sel. 41, 49. -- Cf. ἑανός.
वसन्त: वसन्त वसन्त, m.  1. The season of spring, Pañc. v. d. 4; personified, Lass. 2. ed. 51, 26.  2. Diarrhœa.  3. Small-pox.  -- Comp. सु-, m. the day of full moon in the month Caitra, a festival in honour of Kāma. -- Cf. ἔαρ; Lat. ver.
वसा: वसा वसा, f.  1. Marrow, Nalod. 3, 11; brain (-चटा, the mass of the brain), Kathās. 25, 274.  2. Fat, adeps, Pañc. 253, 23.  3. Oily exudation, Man. 5, 135.
वसिष्ठ: वसिष्ठ वसिष्ठ, m. The name of a Ṛṣi; cf. वशिष्ठ।
वसु: वसु वसु,  I. adj.  1. Sweet.  2. Dry.  II. m.  1. A kind of demigod, Rām. 3, 52, 42; MBh. 1, 2582.  2. A name of Agni.  3. Śiva.  4. Kuvera, Kir. 1, 18.  5. The sun.  6. A ray of light, Śiś. 9, 10 (at the end of a comp. adj.; cf. 2. वस्).  7. A rein.  8. The tie of a yoke.  9. A tree.  10. The name of two plants.  11. A kind of fish.  12. A proper name, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 21.  III. n.  1. Wealth, Lass. 100, 8 = Rigv. vii. 15, 4 (वस्वस्, ved. abl.); Nal. 5, 48; Daśak. in Chr. 184, 14.  2. Gold, MBh. 3, 13472.  3. A gem.  4. Water.  5. A sort of salt.  6. A yellow kind of kidney bean.  -- Comp. पुनर्-, m. 1. the seventh of the lunar asterisms, Ragh. 11, 36. 2. a name of Viṣṇu and Śiva, MBh. 12, 1511. पुरा-, m. a name of Bhīṣma. मित्रावसु, i. e. मित्र-, m. a proper name, Śāk. 79, 2. विभा-, m. 1. the sun, Lass. 2. ed. 78, 76. 2. the moon, Śṛṅgārat. 2. 3. fire. -- Cf. ἐΰς, ἐάων, cf. वस्न।
वसुक: वसुक वसु + क,  I. m.  1. A tree, Sesbana grandiflora.  2. A shrub, As-clepias gigantea.  II. n. Sea salt (cf. वशिर).
वसुधा: वसुधा वसु-धा, f. The earth, Vikr. d. 16.  -- Comp. क्षेत्र-, f. cultivated land, Rām. 3, 4, 17.
वसुधाधर: वसुधाधर वसुधा-धर, i.e. वसुधा-धृ + अ, m. A mountain, Vikr. d. 16.
वसुधार: वसुधार वसुधार, i. e. वसु-धृ + अ, adj. Having wealth, Hit. ii. d. 102 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2220).
वसुन्धरा: वसुंधरा वसुंधरा, i. e. वसु + म् -धृ + अ, f. The earth, Pañc. 101, 23.
वसुंधरा: वसुंधरा वसुंधरा, i. e. वसु + म् -धृ + अ, f. The earth, Pañc. 101, 23.
वसुमत्: वसुमन्त् वसु + मन्त्,  I. adj., f. मती, Wealthy, Johns. Sel. 6, 33.  II. f. मती।  1. The earth, Vikr. d. 79.  2. A proper name.
वसुमन्त्: वसुमन्त् वसु + मन्त्,  I. adj., f. मती, Wealthy, Johns. Sel. 6, 33.  II. f. मती।  1. The earth, Vikr. d. 79.  2. A proper name.
वसूयु: वसूयु वसूयु, i. e. वसूय, a ved. de-nomin. derived from वसु, + उ, adj. De-siring wealth, Chr. 289, 4 = Rigv. i. 49, 4.
वस्क्: † वस्क् वस्क्, वष्क् वष्क्, वक्क् वक्क्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.
वस्कय: वस्कय वस्कय, and वस्कयणी वस्-कयणी, see वष्क।
वस्त्: † वस्त् वस्त्, i. 1, Ātm. To torment.
वस्त: वस्त वस्त,  I. m. A goat, Man. 11, 138.  II. i. e. 1. वस् + त, n. A house.

वस्तु: वस्तु 1. वस् + तु, n.  1. Natural dis-position.  2. Essence, the true object, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 10; substance, wealth, Lass. 12, 14.  3. वस्तुतस्: वस्तुतस् वस्तु + तस्, adv. Essen-tially, in fact, Siddh. Mukt. 76, 4.

वस्त्य: वस्त्य 1. वस् + त्य, or वस्त + य, n. A house.

वस्न: वस्न वस्न,  I. m.  1. Price.  2. Wages.  II. n.  1. Wealth.  2. Abiding (vb. 1. वस्).  3. Substance, thing.  4. Cloth (vb. 3. वस्).  5. 2. वा वा, A particle of,  1. Com-parison, As, Draup. 7, 15; Rām. 1, 10, 37.  2. विक्रयिक: विक्रयिक विक्रयिक, i. e. विक्रय + इक, adj. One who sells.

विक्रान्ति: विक्रान्ति विक्रान्ति, i. e. वि-क्रम् + ति, f.  1. A horse's canter or gallop.  2. Great strength.  3. Prowess.
विक्रायक: विक्रायक विक्रायक, i. e. वि-क्री + अक, m. A seller.
विक्रिया: विक्रिया विक्रिया, i. e. वि-कृ + य, and वि-क्रिया, f.  1. Change, Pañc. i. d. 330; transformation, Śāk. p. 106, 1.  2. A dish prepared from (milk), Man. 5, 25.  3. Disease, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 7.  4. Mischief, Rām. 3, 49, 56.  -- Comp. भूत-, f. epilepsy, possession by evil spirits. स-रोमविक्रिय, i. e. स-रोमन्-, adj. affected with horripilation (as a sign of excessive pleasure), Vikr. d. 12.
विक्रेतृ: विक्रेतृ विक्रेतृ, i. e. वि-क्री + तृ, m. A vendor.
विक्लव: विक्लव विक्लव (cf. क्लव्, but this vb. is dubious; I should prefer a derivation from क्लम्), adj.  1. Overcome with fear or agitation, confused, bewildered, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 16.  2. Disgusted, Śāk. 22, 5.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. intrepid, MBh. 1, 2070.
विक्लेद: विक्लेद विक्लेद, i. e. वि-क्लिद् + अ, m. Dissolution, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 41.
विक्षाव: विक्षाव विक्षाव, i. e. वि-क्षु + अ, m.  1. Cough.  2. Sound.
विक्षेप: विक्षेप विक्षेप, i. e. वि-क्षिप् + अ, m.  1. Casting, or throwing away (च-रण-, Casting asunder of the feet, i. e. striding, Vikr. 60, 14).  2. Dispatching.  3. Refuting an argument.  4. Con-fusion, perplexity, fear, proceeding from ignorance or error, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 23; cf. 206, 8; 217, 24.  5. Look-ing about wildly.  6. Celestial latitude.  -- Comp. चित्त-, m. scattering, diver-sion of mind, Utt. Rāmac. 52, 12. दृष्टि-, m. a leer, a side glance, Śāk. 16, 1, Chezy.

विख्याति: विख्याति वि-ख्या + ति, f.  1. Fame.  2. Notoriety.
विगणन: विगणन वि-गण् + अन, n. Reckoning, computing.

विगर्हण: विगर्हण विगर्हण, i. e. वि-गर्ह् + अन, n.  1. Abusing.  2. Abuse, blame, Chr. 63, 70.
विगान: विगान विगान, i. e. वि-गै + अन, n.  1. Blame.  2. Ill report.
विगाह: विगाह वि-गाह् + अ, m.  1. Bathing.  2. Plunging into, literally and figu-ratively.  -- Comp. दुस्-,  I. adj. impene-trable, unfathomable, Pañc. i. d. 125.  II. m. a proper name, MBh. 1, 4544.
विग्र: विग्र विग्र (perhaps anomal, वि-अग्र), adj. Noseless.
विग्रह: विग्रह वि-ग्रह् + अ,  I. m. and n.  1. War, battle, Pañc. 149, 14; Hit. pr. d. 9, M.M.  2. Opposition, encounter, quarrel, Bhartṛ. 2, 42.  3. Disfavour, Rājat. 5, 247.  II. m.  1. Extension.  2. Shape, Kir. 5, 43.  3. The body, Rām. 5, 2, 15.  4. A portion.  -- Comp. आ -वृत- (vb. वृ), adj., f. हा, whose body is covered, hidden, Vikr. d. 102. स-, adj. 1. embodied, living, Rājat. 5, 27. 2. meaning, importing.
विग्रहवत्: विग्रहवन्त् विग्रह + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Embodied, incarnate, Sāv. 1, 22; Mālav. d. 13; Sund. 3, 17.
विग्रहवन्त्: विग्रहवन्त् विग्रह + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Embodied, incarnate, Sāv. 1, 22; Mālav. d. 13; Sund. 3, 17.

विघट्टना: विघट्टना वि-घट्ट् + अना f. Separa-tion, Nalod. 4, 45.
विघट्टिन्: विघट्टिन् वि-घट्ट् + इन्, adj., f. नी, Touching, Ragh. 16, 56.
विघस: विघस वि-घस् + अ, m.  1. The residue of food offered to the gods, manes (Man. 3, 285), to a venerable guest, or a spi-ritual teacher.  2. Food, Utt. Rāmac. 121, 7.
विघात: विघात विघात, i. e. वि-हन्, Caus., + अ, m. and n.  1. Prohibition.  2. Opposition.  3. Impediment, obstacle, Pañc. 42, 12.  4. Destruction, Sund. 1, 12; Pañc. 156, 23.  5. Abandoning, Pañc. 172, 25.  6. A blow, Vikr. 85, 19 ( दृष्टि-, Being dazzled).  -- Comp. दन्-त-, m. biting, bite, Ṛt. 4, 12.
विघातिन्: विघातिन् विघातिन्, i. e. वि-हन् Caus., + इन्, adj.  1. Opposing, impeding.  2. Removing.  3. Killing.

विघ्न: विघ्न विघ्न, i. e. वि-हन् + अ, m. (n., Sund. 1, 12),  1. Obstacle, Utt. Rāmac. 35, 19; trouble, Śāk. d. 13.  2. Impediment, Pañc. 168, 3.  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj. free from obstacles, unobstructed, Śāk. 13, 23.  II. n. absence of obstruc-tion, Ragh. 1, 91; instr. °नेन, without impediment, Rām. 4, 38, 8. अप-विघ्न + म्, adv. free from impediments, Ragh. 3, 38. क्षण-, m. a delay of a moment, Vikr. d. 17.
विघ्नक: ऽविघ्नक -विघ्न + क, at the end of a comp. adj. Obstructing, impeding, Lass. 5, 3.
विघ्नवत्: विघ्नवन्त् विघ्न + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Obstructed by obstacles, Śāk. 41, 11.
विघ्नवन्त्: विघ्नवन्त् विघ्न + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Obstructed by obstacles, Śāk. 41, 11.
विघ्नित: विघ्नित विघ्नित, i. e. विघ्न + इत, adj. Obstructed, impeded, Pañc. 168, 7; Vikr. d. 49.
विच्: विच् ii. 7, विनच्, विञ्च्, † ii. 3, anomal. वेविच्, Par. Ātm. To separate, to deprive, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 103 (विक्त, Lass. 2, 14, must be changed to रिक्त); cf. 2. विज्। -- With the prep. वि वि,  1. To re-move, MBh. 1, 6372.  2. To change, MBh. 1, 7396.  3. To decide, MBh. 2, 2244. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विविक्त।  1. Sepa-rated.  2. Solitary, Man. 2, 215; 3, 206; Pañc. 159, 21.  3. Scattered, Chr. 29, 29 (perhaps it is to be changed to निविष्-ट).  4. Discriminated.  5. Pure, Bhartṛ. 3, 62.  6. Discriminative.  7. Profound (as thought).  8. Intent on. n. Lone-liness, being alone, Vikr. 40, 5. -- With प्रवि प्र-वि, प्रविविक्त,  1. Separated, Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 13.  2. Solitary, Rām. 2, 48, 59, ed. Seramp. -- Cf. O.H.G. wīcan, A.S. wícan, recedere (per-haps rather to 2. विज्); perhaps also O.H.G. wehsal; A.S. wrixl; εἴκειν; Lat. vicis, invicem, vicissim, and vin-cere, i. e. to cause to cede.
विचक्षण: विचक्षण विचक्षण, i. e. वि-चक्ष् + अन, adj.  1. All-seeing, Chr. 289, 8 = Rigv. i. 112, 8; Chr. 296, 4 = Rigv. i. 112, 4.  2. Discerning, knowing, Pañc. i. d. 59 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 984); circumspect, wise, Bhag. 18, 2; clever.  -- Comp. कार्य-, adj. under-standing to manage affairs, Pañc. i. d. 424 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3241). संधि-, adj. knowing the different kinds of peace-making, Hit. iv. d. 107. सु-, adj. well-discerning, Hit. i. d. 21, M.M.
विचक्षस्: विचक्षस् वि-चक्ष् + अस्, m. A pre-ceptor.
विचय: विचय विचय, i. e. वि-चि + अ, m. Search, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 4; research.
विचयन: विचयन विचयन, i. e. वि-चि + अन, n. Seeking, search.
विचर्षणि: विचर्षणि विचर्षणि (वि, and vb. चर्), adj. Swift, Chr. 291, 12 = Rigv. i. 64, 12.
विचलन: विचलन वि-चल् + अन, n.  1. De-viating from.  2. Unsteadiness.  3. Self-praise, conceit.

Spr. 2891.  -- Comp. अ-विचार + म्, adv. without long consideration, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 13. निस्-, adj. not reflecting, Rājat. 6, 323. °रम्, adv. without long reflec-tion, Rām. 2, 23, 10 Gorr. सु-, m. due consideration. स्वप्न-, m. interpre-tation of dreams.

विचाल: विचाल विचाल, i. e. वि-चल् + अ, adj. Intervening, intermediate.

विच्छन्द: विच्छन्द विच्छन्द, and विच्छन्दक विच्छन्द + क, m.  1. A palace.  2. A temple.

विशसन: विशसन वि-शस् + अन,  I. n.  1. Dis-secting.  2. Killing, ruin, Utt. Rāmac. 96, 5.  II. m. A crooked sword.
विशसितृ: विशसितृ वि-शस् + इतृ, m., f. त्री, and n.  1. Who or what dissects, Man. 5, 51.  2. Who or what kills.
विशाख: विशाख  I. वि-शाख (cf. शाखा), adj. Branchless.  II. m.  1. Kārttikeya.  2. An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart.  3. A solicitor, a beggar.  4. A spindle.  III. f. खा, The sixteenth lunar asterism, Lass. 16, 18.
विशातन: विशातन विशातन, i. e. वि-शातय, (Caus. of शद्), + अन, adj., f. नी, Causing to fall asunder, Bhāg. P. 3, 14, 4.
विशाय: विशाय विशाय, i. e. वि-शी + अ, m. Sleeping and watching alternately.
विशारण: विशारण विशारण, i. e. वि-शॄ + अन, n. Killing.
विशारद: विशारद विशारद,  1. Learned, wise.  2. Skilled, conversant with, Pañc. ii. d. 14; Chr. 5, 5.  3. Famous.  4. Bold, presuming.
विशाल: विशाल विशाल (perhaps vb. श्रि),  I. adj.  1. Great, large, Hit. 14, 4, M.M.  2. Broad.  3. Eminent, illustrious, Hit. pr. d. 39. M.M.  II. m. A sort of deer.  III. f. ला।  1. The city Ougein, Megh. 31, and another town.  2. Bitter apple, Cucumis colocynthis.
विशालता: विशालता विशाल + ता, f.  1. Mag-nitude.  2. Breadth.  3. Distinction.
विशिख: विशिख वि-शिख (probably from शिखा),  I. m.  1. An arrow, Chr. 34, 13; Rājat. 5, 221 ( उत्खायमान-, adj. While the arrow was drawn out).  2. An iron crow.  II. f. खा।  1. A sort of needle.  2. A spade.  3. A highway.  -- Comp. कटाक्ष-, m. an arrow-like amorous look, Bhartṛ. 2, 76.
विशिष्टता: विशिष्टता वि-शिष्ट + ता (vb. शिष्), f.  1. Excellence, distinction, Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M.  2. Individuality, having distinguishing properties.  3. Pecu-liarity, as of duty.
विशुद्धि: विशुद्धि विशुद्धि, i. e. वि-शुध् + ति, f.  1. Purity, Man. 5, 67; 9, 9.  2. Cor-rectness.  3. Purifying, purification, Bhag. 6, 12; Utt. Rāmac. 9, 17.  4. Sameness.  5. Removal of doubt.
विशेष: विशेष विशेष, i. e. वि-शिष् + अ, m.  1. Difference, Pañc. 219, 14; at the end of comp. words, Different, e. g. गति-, m. Different ways, Pañc. 247, 11. पुरुष-, This or that man, Pañc. i. d. 124.  2. Special property, Hit. pr. d. 25, M.M.  3. A change for the better, Mālav. 46, 9.  4. Sort, kind, manner, Megh. 65; Hit. ii. d. 149; Pañc. 114, 25; a different object, Megh. 58.  5. Excellence, superiority; विशेषेण, Particularly, Pañc. 142, 15; 162, 9; at the end of comp. words, Excellent; e. g. भक्ष-, m. Excellent food, Pañc. 113, 9; 117, 2, cf. my transl. n. 767; Vikr. d. 142.  6. A limb.  7. A mark on the forehead with sandal.  8. Speciality, charac-teristic marks, Lass. 13, 4 ( तपस्विन्-, of an ascetic).  9. Abl. विशेषात्, Especi-ally, Pañc. ii. d. 100; even more, just for that, Pañc. 109, 19.  -- Comp. अ-विशेष + म्, adv. without choosing, Arj. 3, 32. तपोविशेष, i. e. तपस्-, m. pl. various modes of devotion, Man. 2, 165. दशा-, m. a special condition, Hit. 78, 8, M.M. निस्-,  I. m. want of difference, Hit. 113, 11.  II. adj. 1. having no discrimination, Hit. ii. d. 68. 2. not different. 3. equal. 4. acc. षम्, adv. a. without difference, Hit. 84, 5, M.M. b. alike, Hit. 128, 10. c. exceedingly, Utt. Rāmac. 99, 6. प्रसाधन-, m. highest accom-plishment, Vikr. d. 22. रस-, m. a more excellent juice, Pañc. ii. d. 37. स-, adj. 1. having discrimination, Hit. 55, 13. 2. having characteristic qualities. 3. extraordinary, Hit. 60, 6, M.M.
विशेषक: विशेषक विशेषक, i. e. वि-शिष् + अक,  I. adj. Discriminative, distin-guishing.  II. m. and n.  1. An attri-bute, a predicate.  2. A mark on the forehead made with sandal, etc., and worn either as an ornament, Mālav. d. 40; Daśak. in Chr. 199, 4, or sectarial distinction.  -- Comp. पत्र-, strokes and lines drawn on the face with fragrant pigments of sandal, musk, etc., Ragh. 3, 55. वि-प्र-नष्ट- (vb. नश्), adj., f. का, one whose discriminative faculty or perception has disappeared, Rām. 3, 55, 6. स-, adj. discriminated, having distinguishing properties, Bhāṣāp. 1.
विशेषज्ञ: विशेषज्ञ विशेष-ज्ञ, adj.  1. Deeply learned, Hit. 129, 9; iv. d. 98.  2. Wise, intelligent.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. having no judgment, Hit. iii. d. 126.
विशेषण: विशेषण विशेषण, i. e. वि-शिष् + अन,  I. adj.  1. Discriminative.  2. Distinctive.  II. n.  1. Distinguishing, discriminating.  2. An attribute, epi-thet, Vikr. 20, 3.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. without attributes, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 34. स-, adj. distinguished, characterised.
विशेषणता: विशेषणता विशेषण + ता, f. The state of being a distinguishing mark, Bhāṣāp. 60; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. pp. 13, 55, n.
विशेषणवत्: विशेषणवन्त् विशेषण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having a distinguishing attri-bute, Bhāṣāp. 131.
विशेषणवन्त्: विशेषणवन्त् विशेषण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having a distinguishing attri-bute, Bhāṣāp. 131.
विशेषतस्: विशेषतस् विशेष + तस्, adv. Espe-cially, Hit. 80, 1, M.M.; particularly, Vikr. d. 62.  -- Comp. स-, adv. parti-cularly, excellently.
विशेषवत्: विशेषवन्त् विशेष + वन्त्, adj.  1. Peculiar.  2. Excellent.  3. Superior, better, Johns. Sel. 17, 73.
विशेषवन्त्: विशेषवन्त् विशेष + वन्त्, adj.  1. Peculiar.  2. Excellent.  3. Superior, better, Johns. Sel. 17, 73.
विशेष्यक: विशेष्यक विशेष्य + क (vb. शिष्), latter part of a comp. adj. in तद्वद्-विशेष्यक, i. e. तद्वन्त्-, Relating to an object possessing such an attribute, Bhāṣāp. 134; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. 61, 1-6.
विशोधन: विशोधन विशोधन, i. e. वि-शुध् + अन,  I. n.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying, Rām. 1, 26, 19.  3. Expiation, Man. 11, 143; 156.  II. f. नी, The capital of Brahman.
विशोधित्व: विशोधित्व विशोधित्व, i. e. विशोधिन् + त्व, n.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying.  3. Freeing from obstructions, clearing, Hit. iii. d. 86.
विशोधिन्: विशोधिन् विशोधिन्, i. e. वि-शुध् + इन्, adj.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying.  3. Clearing.
विशोषण: विशोषण विशोषण, i. e. वि-शुष् + अन,  I. adj.(?), Drying, Arj. 8, 8; the name of a weapon.  II. n. Drying.  -- Comp. तालु-, n. the growing dry of the palate (by much speaking), MBh. 8, 4760.
विश्न: विश्न विश्न, i. e. 2. विछ् + न, m. Splendour, Pāṇ. iii. 3, 90; vi. 4, 19.
विश्पति: विश्पति विश्-पति, m. Lord of the house, Lass. 100, 13 = Rigv. vii. 15, 7.
विश्पला: विश्पला विश्पला, f. A proper name, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.
विश्रणन: विश्रणन and विश्राणन विश्रा̆णन, i. e. वि-श्रण् + अन, n. Gift, donation, Ragh. 2, 54 (आ).
विश्रम: विश्रम वि-श्रम् + अ, m. Rest, re-pose, quiet, Vikr. d. 42.
विश्रम्भ: विश्रम्भ वि-श्रम्भ् + अ (also विस्रम्भ विस्रम्भ), m.  1. Trust, confidence, Pañc. i. d. 306; ii. d. 190.  2. Affec-tion, Hit. 46, 1, M.M. (-आलाप, Affec-tionate talk).  3. Sportive noise.
विश्रम्भिन्: विश्रम्भिन् विश्रम्भिन्, i. e. वि-श्रम्भ्, and विश्रम्भ, + इन्, also विस्रम्भिन् विस्रम्भिन्, adj.  1. Trusting, confiding in.  2. Trustworthy, MBh. 1, 5845 (स्).
विश्रय: विश्रय विश्रय, i. e. वि-श्रि + अ, m.  1. Abode, asylum.  2. Dependence upon.
विश्रयिन्: विश्रयिन् विश्रयिन्, adj.  1. Living or dwelling in.  2. Depending on.
विश्रवस्: विश्रवस् वि-श्रवस्, m. A proper name, Rām. 3, 53, 30.
विश्रान्ति: विश्रान्ति विश्रान्ति, i. e. वि-श्रम् + ति, f. Rest, repose, Vikr. d. 20; Kathās. 22, 104 (रतेस् -- वासवेश्मेव विश्रान्त्यै --आवयोर् अभवत्, literally, It was for us like the sleeping-room of the god-dess of love for reposing in).
विश्राम: विश्राम विश्राम, i. e. वि-श्रम् + अ, m.  1. Rest, repose, Pañc. 145, 9; Hit. i. d. 138, M.M.  2. Stop, pause, Utt. Rāmac. 103, 13.
विश्राव: विश्राव विश्राव, i. e. वि-श्रु + अ, m., and विश्रुति वि-श्रु + ति, f. Fame, cele-brity, notoriety.  -- Comp. लोक-विश्रुति, f. 1. fame. 2. unfounded rumour.
विश्लथ: विश्लथ वि-श्लथ् + अ, adj. Relaxed, Ragh. 6, 73; languid.
विश्लेष: विश्लेष विश्लेष, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + अ, m.  1. Separation, Pañc., 225, 18 (with सह); disunion.  2. A chasm, Kathās. 2, 49.  -- Comp. चित्त-, m. separation of the hearts, loss of friendship, Pañc. 225, 17 (with instr.).
विश्लेषिन्: विश्लेषिन् विश्लेषिन्, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + इन्, adj. Falling, Ragh. 16, 67.
विश्व: विश्व विश्व, probably वि-श्वि (cf. the aor. of श्वि, अ-श्वम्, and शश्वन्त्),  I. adj.  1. All, every, Lass. 97, 2 = Rigv. vi. 64, 1; every one, Lass. 101, 4 = Rigv. vii. 16, 1; particularly former part of comp. words, cf. विश्व-कर्मन्, विश्वकृत्, etc.  2. Whole.  3. Uni-versal.  II. m.  1. A term of the Vedāntra philosophy, the faculty per-ceiving singleness, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 13.  2. pl. (विश्वे), A class of deities, Indr. 2, 13.  III. n. The world, Śāk. d. 1.  IV. (n. and) f. वा, Dry ginger.  V. f. वा, A tree, a plant, Aconitum ferox.
विश्वकद्रु: विश्वकद्रु विश्व + क-द्रु,  I. adj. Wicked.  II. m.  1. A dog trained for the chase.  2. Sound.
विश्वकृत्: विश्वकृत् विश्व-कृ + त्, m.  1. The creator.  2. A son of Brahman, the artist of the gods (= विश्व-कर्मन्), Sund. 3, 13, cf. 10.
विश्वजनीन: विश्वजनीन विश्वजनीन, विश्वजनीय विश्वजनीय, and विश्वजन्य विश्वजन्य, i. e. विश्व-जन + ईन, or ईय, or य, adj. Good for all men, universally salutary, Man. 9, 31 (-जन्य).
विश्वजित्: विश्वजित् विश्व-जि + त्,  I. adj. All-sub-duing.  II. m.  1. A particular sacrifice, Man. 11, 74.  2. The noose of Varuṇa.
विश्वञ्च्: विश्वञ्च् विश्वञ्च्, A false writing for विष्वञ्च्, q. cf.
विश्वतुर्: विश्वतुर् विश्व-तुर्, adj. All-subdu-ing, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16.
विश्वद्र्यञ्च्: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् विश्वद्र्यञ्च्, i. e. विश्व + त्र-अञ्च् (with द् for त्; cf. also तिर्यञ्च्), adj., f. द्रीची, Moving everywhere.
विश्वप्सन्: विश्वप्सन् विश्वप्सन्, i. e. विश्व-भस् + अन् (properly the curtailed ptcple. of the pres.), m.  1. A god.  2. Fire.  3. The sun.  4. The moon.
विश्वम्भर: विश्वंभर विश्वंभर, i. e. विश्व + म् -भृ + अ,  I. adj. All-sustaining.  II. m.  1. Viṣṇu.  2. Indra.  III. f. रा, The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 11.
विश्वंभर: विश्वंभर विश्वंभर, i. e. विश्व + म् -भृ + अ,  I. adj. All-sustaining.  II. m.  1. Viṣṇu.  2. Indra.  III. f. रा, The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 11.
विश्वसन: विश्वसन वि-श्वस् + अन, n. Trusting, confiding in.
विश्वसनीयता: विश्वसनीयता i. e. वि-श्वसनीय + ता (vb. श्वस्), f. Inspiring confidence, Śāk. 27, 17.
विश्वसह: विश्वसह विश्व-सह् + अ,  I. adj. All-enduring.  II. f.  1. The earth.  2. One of the tongues of fire.
विश्वसुविद्: विश्वसुविद् विश्व-सु-विद्, adj. Giving everything well, Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.
विश्वसृज्: विश्वसृज् विश्व-सृज् (nom. sing. -सृट् and सृक्, MBh. 14, 7367), m.  1. The creator of the universe, MBh. 1. 1.; Śiś. 9, 80.  2. Brahman.
विश्वाची: विश्वाची विश्वाची, i. e. विश्व-अञ्च् + ई, f. The name of an Apsaras, Lass. 2. ed. 50, 22.
विश्वामित्र: विश्वामित्र विश्वामित्र, i. e. विश्व -मित्र, m. The name of a Muni, Johns. Sel. 23, 118.
विश्वावसु: विश्वावसु विश्वावसु, i. e. विश्व-वसु, m.  1. One of the Manus.  2. One of the Gandharvas, Indr. 2, 18.
विश्वास: विश्वास विश्वास, i. e. वि-श्वस् + अ, m.  1. Confidence, trust, Pañc. ii. d. 23.  2. Faith, Vikr. 71, 13.  3. Secret, Hit. 73, 16.  -- Comp. अ-, m. 1. want of con-fidence, distrust, Pañc. i. d. 295. 2. treachery(?), Rām. 3, 52, 48. °शम्, adv. without confiding, distrustfully, Pañc. iii. d. 59.
विश्वासन: विश्वासन (or ना?), विश्वासन (or ना), i. e. वि-श्वस्, Caus., + अन, n. (or f.), Producing confidence, Pañc. 165, 15.
विश्वासिन्: विश्वासिन् विश्वासिन्, i. e. वि-श्वस्, and विश्वास, + इन्, adj., f. नी,  1. Trusting.  2. Trusty, honest.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. mistrustful, Megh. 111.
विश्वासैकसार: विश्वासैकसार विश्वासैकसार, i. e. विश्वास-एक-सार, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 44.
विश्वेभोजस्: विश्वेभोजस् विश्वेभोजस् (i. e. विश्व and भोजस्), m. A name of Indra, Matsyapurāṇa, see Aufrecht, Ujjvalad. p. 250, n.
विष्: † 1. विष् विष्, i. 1, Par. To sprinkle.

2. विष् विष्, ii. 3, वेविष्, Par. Ātm. To pervade, to embrace, etc. (ved.). -- With the prep. परि परि, Caus.  1. To present, to offer, Man. 3, 228; to offer food, MBh. 1, 7182 (where it is written with श् instead of ष्).  2. To wait on, Rām. 1, 13, 14.
† 3. विष् ii. 9, विष्णा, विष्णी, Par. To separate.
4. विष् विष्, f. Excrement, Man. 4, 48.  -- Comp. कर्ण-, f. ear-wax, Man. 5, 135.
विष: विष विष,  I. m. and n. Poison, Pañc. iii. d. 83 (n.).  II. n.  1. Water.  2. See विस।  -- Comp. कर्ण-, n. poison sprinkled in one's ears (treacherous speech), Pañc. i. d. 338. दूषी-, n. vegetable poison that has become old and diminished in strength, Suśr. 2, 254, 7. दृष्टि-, m. a snake, Kir. 14, 25. निस्-, adj., f. षा, deprived of poison, Pañc. iii. d. 83. नेत्र-, adj. having poison in one's eyes, MBh. 2, 2140. महा-, m. a small venomous snake, Rām. 3, 53, 55. लाला-, m. an insect whose spittle is poison, as a spider. -- Cf. Lat. virus; ἰός, ἴον; Lat. viola (poison is connected with blue, cf. विष-पुष्प, and Śiva's neck grow-ing blue, by swallowing the poison churned out of the sea).
विषङ्ग: विषङ्ग विषङ्ग, i. e. वि-सञ्ज् + अ, m. Attachment.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. indif-ferent, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 51.
विषण्णता: विषण्णता विषण्ण + ता (vb. सद्), f. Dejection, want of energy.
विषता: विषता विष + ता, f. State of poison, Śiś. 9, 68.
विषद: विषद विष-द,  I. adj.  1. Giving poison.  2. Shedding water.  II. m. A cloud.  III. n. Green vitriol.
विषदर्शनमृत्युक: विषदर्शनमृत्युक विष-दर्शन-मृ-त्यु + क, m. A kind of pheasant.
विषधर: विषधर विषधर, i. e. विष-धृ + अ,  I. adj. Venomous.  II. m. A snake.
विषम: विषम विषम, i. e. वि-सम,  I. adj., f. मा।  1. Unequal, different, Kir. 5, 40.  2. Inconstant, Hit. ii. d. 104.  3. Odd (in numbers), figurat., Pañc. i. d. 126.  4. Unhappy, Hit. iv. d. 3.  5. Un-paralleled, unequalled, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.  6. Uneven, Pañc. ii. d. 188; sloping, Vikr. 10, 9.  7. Rough, Vikr. d. 49; Pañc. 188, 9.  8. Difficult, pain-ful, Bhartṛ. 2, 54; disagreeable, Pañc. i. d. 12.  9. Frightful, Hit. iii. d. 133.  10. Dishonest, wicked, Hiḍ. 1, 39; Hit. ii. d. 111.  11. Partial, Man. 7, 27.  II. n.  1.
